open_risks.risk: Rollout labels may depend on geometry not visible in the initial RGB.
open_risks.mitigation: Require a visible-local gate for every category: relevant swept path or failure evidence must be visible or locally inferable, ambiguous=false, repeat-stable, and not caused by occluded/depth-hole/glass/overhang cases.

open_risks.risk: Blind, radius-only, action-only, or majority baselines may exploit answer imbalance or prompt leakage.
open_risks.mitigation: Enforce per-category answer caps, prompt linting for answer-leaking words, and shortcut baselines before accepting generated manifests.

open_risks.risk: Body counterfactual results may collapse into a radius prior instead of testing body-conditioned geometry.
open_risks.mitigation: Require identical RGB/start/action, true flip pairs, no-flip controls, radius monotonicity checks, and radius-only baseline reporting.

open_risks.risk: Hazard labels may drift into semantic guessing rather than physical rollout consequences.
open_risks.mitigation: Keep hazard explanation diagnostic, derive labels from rollout evidence first, and score insufficient-support only when a concrete support-loss backend signal exists.

open_risks.risk: The visible-local projection gate may reduce yield, especially for contact cases near image borders or behind partial occlusions.
open_risks.mitigation: Oversample scans/episodes/action motifs before downsampling; keep visible_gate_pass=false candidates for audit only, not scoring.

open_risks.risk: Habitat config drift could make prompt meters/angles mismatch executed actions.
open_risks.mitigation: Freeze move_forward=0.25 m and turn_left/right=15 degrees in the generator config; render all prompt horizons from serialized action_sequence metadata.

open_risks.risk: Body-radius counterfactual labels can be invalid if simulator radius settings or navmesh handling violate monotonicity.
open_risks.mitigation: Reject any pair where progress_small + tolerance < progress_large; mark as oracle_error and audit simulator body profile configuration.

open_risks.risk: Insufficient-support hazard may be unavailable in some Habitat builds.
open_risks.mitigation: Require support_loss/navmesh_support_violation fields to emit insufficient_support; otherwise exclude that label from accepted v1 scoring and report reduced hazard ontology.

open_risks.risk: Rendered prompts may still leak labels if generation bypasses linting.
open_risks.mitigation: Run prompt lint on every final Chinese question and reject scene/safety adjectives including 畅通, 堵住, 更宽, 更窄, 开阔走廊, 安全, 危险 and their English equivalents.

open_risks.risk: The visible-local gate may reject many candidates.
open_risks.mitigation: Oversample MP3D/R2R-CE starts and downsample after visibility, stability, margin, and answer-balance gates.

open_risks.risk: Insufficient-ground-support labels are invalid without a concrete backend field.
open_risks.mitigation: Only assign insufficient_support when support_loss or navmesh_support_violation is present; otherwise use the three-way hazard variant.

open_risks.risk: Cases may test hidden future geometry rather than consequence reasoning from the initial single RGB.
open_risks.mitigation: Add an executable visible-local gate that projects the rollout centerline/swept samples and first contact or hazard point into the initial camera, checks valid depth and non-occlusion, and rejects failures.

open_risks.risk: Prompts may describe horizons or angles that do not match simulator actions.
open_risks.mitigation: Freeze forward step size, turn increment, action sequence serialization, intended distance computation, and generate all prompt meters/body-widths/angles from those values.

open_risks.risk: Body counterfactual accuracy may be solvable by radius priors if true flips and no-flip controls are undersampled.
open_risks.mitigation: Require explicit accepted-pair quotas by canonical label and control type, plus radius-only baseline reporting before accepting a generated manifest.

open_risks.risk: Hazard questions may become semantic-label QA instead of rollout-grounded physical consequence QA.
open_risks.mitigation: Require a concrete support-loss backend signal or remove insufficient_ground_support from v1 scoring.

open_risks.risk: Cases may test hidden future geometry rather than visible local RGB evidence.
open_risks.mitigation: Require visible_gate_pass by projecting rollout samples and first contact/hazard points into the start camera; reject occluded, depth-hole, glass/mirror, overhang, and hidden-space cases.

open_risks.risk: Prompt horizons may not match simulator execution.
open_risks.mitigation: Freeze forward_step_size_m, turn_step_deg, serialized action_sequence, and intended_distance_m computation; render prompts only from these fields.

open_risks.risk: Body Counterfactual can collapse into a radius prior shortcut.
open_risks.mitigation: Enforce balanced both_safe, small_only, and neither_safe labels, explicit no-flip controls, monotonicity checks, and radius-only baseline reporting.

open_risks.risk: Natural-language answers may be scored inconsistently or leak labels.
open_risks.mitigation: Use Chinese templates with canonical labels, accepted aliases, unmatched-answer policy, and prompt linting against label-leaking scene/safety words.

open_risks.risk: The insufficient-ground-support hazard label may become semantic rather than rollout-grounded.
open_risks.mitigation: Require an explicit support_loss/navmesh_support_violation backend field or remove/merge this label in v1 scoring.

benchmark_design.objective: Evaluate whether MLLMs can predict the local physical consequence of an ego action from a single egocentric RGB image by binding visible local geometry, the agent body footprint, and the action-induced swept volume.
benchmark_design.reference_policy: Use VSI-Bench / Thinking in Space, SpatialBench, A4Bench, CapNav, and TouchSafeBench only as methodology anchors. Do not copy their taxonomies, do not use legacy T1/T2/T3/T4/T5 category IDs, do not ask centimeter-level metric geometry questions, and do not expose depth, pose, navmesh, semantic maps, or rollout traces to the tested model.

categories.title: Local Progress Estimation
categories.literature_anchor: VSI-Bench / Thinking in Space measurement-style design adapted to coarse rollout-derived local progress bins.
categories.motivation_link: Tests H1: whether the model estimates body-relative progress from visible egocentric geometry rather than only describing apparent free space.
categories.r2r_labeling_rule: From a valid Habitat/R2R-CE start state, render initial RGB for the model-facing item, then offline execute a direct-forward action sequence for body radius r. Label from actual_distance_m, intended_distance_m, progress_ratio, collision, stopped_early, height_delta_m, hazard_type, and replayable rollout trace.
categories.case_acceptance_criteria: Question states body radius/width and approximate forward horizon. Accept only visible-local, repeat-stable, margin-separated, non-ambiguous progress cases; reject stair/drop/support-risk outcomes from this category and enforce answer balance.

categories.title: Action-Horizon Collision
categories.literature_anchor: SpatialBench causality/planning-level design and A4Bench static-vs-action-conditioned split, localized to short ego-body rollout feasibility.
categories.motivation_link: Tests H1: whether the model binds a concrete turn/forward action sequence to completion or failure in currently visible local space.
categories.r2r_labeling_rule: Execute the specified move_forward / turn_left / turn_right sequence for radius r over a 1/2/3/5/10-action horizon. Mark feasible only if rollout completes with adequate progress and no collision, stopped_early event, unsafe height change, or support violation.
categories.case_acceptance_criteria: Question states body size, action phrase, total actions, and approximate forward displacement. Trace must be replayable and stable; hidden-space, threshold-near, and visually ambiguous cases are rejected; binary answer share is capped.

categories.title: Directional Rollout Comparison
categories.literature_anchor: VSI-Bench / Thinking in Space configurational and relative-direction design adapted to comparing simulated action outcomes.
categories.motivation_link: Tests H1: whether the model binds left/straight/right egocentric directions to traversable swept-volume progress instead of using a center prior.
categories.r2r_labeling_rule: From the same start RGB, pose, yaw, and body radius, roll out left-turn-then-forward, straight-forward, and right-turn-then-forward candidates. Label the direction with the largest actual_distance_m only when margin-separated and repeat-stable.
categories.case_acceptance_criteria: Question states body size, turn angle, and matched forward horizon. Reject near ties unless routed to a separate about-same diagnostic outside core scoring; enforce direction answer balance.

categories.title: Body Counterfactual Flip
categories.literature_anchor: CapNav capability-conditioned evaluation localized to same-image ground-plane body-radius swept-volume feasibility.
categories.motivation_link: Tests H3: whether changing only footprint radius changes the predicted consequence when simulator GT flips.
categories.r2r_labeling_rule: For identical RGB, start pose, yaw, and action sequence, execute paired rollouts for small and large cylindrical ground-plane radii with fixed camera height. Label both-safe, small-only, or neither-safe; reject only-large as oracle_error under radius monotonicity.
categories.case_acceptance_criteria: Start pose is legal for all radii; paired traces are saved; true flips and no-flip controls are included; smaller body is no worse than larger within tolerance; three-way answer balance and radius-only baseline reporting are required.

categories.title: Local Hazard Explanation
categories.literature_anchor: TouchSafeBench collision-grounding principle adapted to coarse local hazard type from a single RGB image and hypothetical ego action.
categories.motivation_link: Diagnostic for H1: checks whether failure judgments are grounded in rollout-derived collision, step/drop, or support risk rather than yes/no priors.
categories.r2r_labeling_rule: Execute the specified short rollout and derive dominant hazard_type from collision, stopped_early, height_delta_m, support/fall indicators when available, progress_ratio, rollout trace, and offline semantic context. Semantic context can support filtering/display but cannot override rollout evidence.
categories.case_acceptance_criteria: Question states body size and action horizon. Hazard must be visible or locally inferable; mixed, hidden, unstable, or purely semantic cases are rejected. This category remains diagnostic and outside the core death-gate.

instantiation_spec.semantic_context_policy: Save RGB/depth/pose/semantic context and rollout metadata only for offline GT, filtering, visualization, and audit. The evaluated model receives only the initial RGB and question. Accept only visible_gate_pass=true computed by projecting sampled swept-cylinder footprint boundary and interior points over rollout time plus first contact or hazard points into the initial camera. Require valid depth and no nearer observed occluder for decisive samples. For body counterfactual pairs, run this visibility gate for both small and large radii. Reject hidden-space-dependent outcomes, depth holes, glass/mirror, overhangs, extremely thin obstacles, missing traces, unstable repeats, and threshold-near labels. Semantic context may support filtering/display but cannot override rollout outcomes. Emit insufficient_support only with support_loss=true or navmesh_support_violation=true.
instantiation_spec.natural_question_policy: Prompts must be natural Chinese and state body radius or width, action direction or turn angle where applicable, action horizon, and approximate meter/body-width horizon rendered from serialized rollout metadata. Ban answer-leaking scene/safety adjectives. Action-Horizon core prompts should be binary; failure subtypes belong to diagnostic scoring or hazard QA unless multiclass subtype balance is enforced.

categories.template: 机器人半径约 {radius_m} 米、宽约 {body_width_m} 米。只看这张第一视角图，如果它从当前位置直接向前走 {num_forward_steps} 步、约 {horizon_m} 米，实际大概会怎样？请只答：基本走完 / 走过一半 / 只走一点。
categories.gt_rule: Execute the exact direct-forward action_sequence from the Habitat start pose using the selected body radius. Label only from rollout_outcome, actual_distance_m, intended_distance_m, progress_ratio, collision, stopped_early, height_delta_m, hazard_type, visible_gate_pass, and replayable rollout_trace_path.
categories.coarse_labeling_rule: Canonical labels: almost_all, more_than_half, only_a_little. Reject from this category, rather than labeling, if collision/contact-caused stop, abs(height_delta_m)>=0.20, support_loss=true, navmesh_support_violation=true, hazard_type marks stair/drop/support risk, or the case is semantically a stair/step/drop/support-risk context. almost_all if progress_ratio>=0.85 with no collision/stopped_early and abs(height_delta_m)<0.15; more_than_half if 0.50<=progress_ratio<0.85 without hazard; only_a_little if 0.10<=progress_ratio<0.50 without hazard. Reject labels within 0.05 progress_ratio of a threshold or unstable under repeat rollout. Single answer share <=0.40.

categories.template: 机器人半径约 {radius_m} 米、宽约 {body_width_m} 米。它按这个短动作执行：{action_phrase}。总共 {num_actions} 个动作，预计向前推进约 {horizon_m} 米。这个短动作大概率能完成吗？请只答：能完成 / 不能完成。
categories.gt_rule: Execute the serialized sequence of move_forward, turn_left, and turn_right with total_action_count in {1,2,3,5,10}. Use forward_step_size_m=0.25 and turn_step_deg=15. Feasibility is determined only from rollout_outcome, progress_ratio, collision, stopped_early, height_delta_m, support fields, hazard_type, visible_gate_pass, and replayable trace.
categories.coarse_labeling_rule: Canonical labels: complete, not_complete. complete if progress_ratio>=0.85, collision=false, stopped_early=false, abs(height_delta_m)<0.15, and no support violation. not_complete otherwise when failure is rollout-confirmed and visible-local. Reject unstable or margin-near labels. Binary answer share <=0.65. If failure subtype choices are rendered for a diagnostic variant, enforce single-choice share <=0.40 over all rendered choices and score subtype accuracy separately.

categories.template: 机器人半径约 {radius_m} 米、宽约 {body_width_m} 米。从当前位置比较三个动作，每个都向前走 {num_forward_steps} 步、约 {horizon_m} 米：左转约 {direction_deg} 度后前进、直接前进、右转约 {direction_deg} 度后前进。哪一个实际推进距离最大？请只答：左转 / 直行 / 右转。
categories.gt_rule: From identical start RGB, pose, yaw, and body radius, execute matched left-turn-then-forward, straight-forward, and right-turn-then-forward rollouts. Store action_sequence, intended_distance_m, actual_distance_m, progress_ratio, collision, height_delta_m, and trace for each candidate. Compare candidates only after all three pass visibility and replayability checks.
categories.coarse_labeling_rule: Canonical labels: left, straight, right. Label only when top1_actual_distance_m - top2_actual_distance_m >= max(distance_tolerance_m, 0.20*intended_distance_m) and repeat rollouts preserve the winner. Reject ties unless routed to a separate about-same diagnostic outside core scoring. Single direction share <=0.48.

categories.template: 同一张图、同一起点、同样直接向前走 {num_forward_steps} 步、约 {horizon_m} 米。小机器人半径 {small_radius_m} 米，宽机器人半径 {large_radius_m} 米。哪个更可能完成这个动作？请只答：两个都能 / 只有小机器人能 / 两个都不能。
categories.gt_rule: For identical start RGB, pose, yaw, and action_sequence, roll out small and large cylindrical ground-plane radii with fixed camera height. Save traces and rollout fields for both bodies. Label both_safe, small_only, or neither_safe; reject only_large as oracle_error. The start pose must be legal for small, standard, and large profiles.
categories.coarse_labeling_rule: Canonical labels: both_safe, small_only, neither_safe. both_safe if both bodies have progress_ratio>=0.85 with no hazard; small_only if small is feasible and large is infeasible by collision, stopped_early, progress_ratio<0.50, height/support hazard, or support violation; neither_safe if small is also infeasible. Reject near-threshold pairs and any pair where progress_small + distance_tolerance_m < progress_large. For every 30 accepted pairs require at least 8 small_only true flips, at least 6 both_safe controls, at least 6 neither_safe controls, at least 4 large_shorter_same_bin controls, and at least 4 radius-stable direction-ranking controls; no canonical label may exceed 14 and single label share must remain <=0.48.

categories.template: 机器人半径约 {radius_m} 米、宽约 {body_width_m} 米。如果它{action_phrase}、总共约 {horizon_m} 米，结果更可能是哪一种？请只答：碰撞 / 台阶或落差 / 地面支撑不足 / 没有明显问题。
categories.gt_rule: Use rollout collision, stopped_early, height_delta_m, support_loss or navmesh_support_violation when available, progress_ratio, hazard_type, visible_gate_pass, and offline semantic context to assign the dominant hazard type. Semantic context alone cannot create a label. If support fields are unavailable, render the three-way variant without 地面支撑不足.
categories.coarse_labeling_rule: Canonical labels: collision, step_or_drop, insufficient_support, no_obvious_risk. collision for contact or contact-caused stopped_early; step_or_drop for abs(height_delta_m)>=0.20 or rollout-confirmed stair/drop hazard; insufficient_support only for support_loss=true or navmesh_support_violation=true; no_obvious_risk only if rollout completes stably with no collision/stopped_early, abs(height_delta_m)<0.15, and no support violation. Reject ambiguous mixed hazards and unstable first-contact bins. Single answer share <=0.40.

risks.risk: A weak implementation of the visible-local filter could admit hidden-space or body-envelope-hidden cases.
risks.mitigation: In instantiation, validate projected swept-volume boundary and interior samples, not only centerline samples; for counterfactual pairs, run this check for both radii.

risks.risk: Action-Horizon Collision could become a failure-subtype prior task if rendered as multi-class without subtype balance.
risks.mitigation: Keep core scoring binary feasibility, or enforce full rendered-choice balance and report subtype accuracy only as diagnostic.

risks.risk: Body counterfactual cases can still be solved by radius priors if no-flip controls are underspecified.
risks.mitigation: Require explicit quotas for true small-only flips plus both-safe, neither-safe, and large-shorter-same-bin controls, and report radius-only baseline performance.

risks.risk: Local Hazard Explanation may drift into semantic scene recognition rather than rollout-grounded consequence QA.
risks.mitigation: Keep it diagnostic; derive labels from rollout fields first, and emit insufficient-support only with support_loss or navmesh_support_violation evidence.

risks.risk: The stronger visible swept-envelope gate may reduce yield, especially for 10-action horizons and side-grazing contacts.
risks.mitigation: Oversample by scan_id, episode_id, action horizon, action motif, geometry tag, body profile, and preliminary label bin before applying validity and balance gates.

risks.risk: Insufficient-support labels are invalid if the backend lacks concrete support signals.
risks.mitigation: Emit insufficient_support only when support_loss=true or navmesh_support_violation=true; otherwise render the hazard category without that answer option.

risks.risk: Simulator body-profile configuration may silently break radius monotonicity.
risks.mitigation: Reject and audit any paired counterfactual rollout where the smaller radius has lower actual distance or progress than the larger radius beyond tolerance.

risks.risk: Binary Action-Horizon loses failure-reason supervision in the core score.
risks.mitigation: Keep failure_subtype_metadata for HTML and diagnostics, and use Local Hazard Explanation for model-facing hazard-type scoring.

risks.risk: Visible-local filtering may reduce yield after adding swept-envelope visibility checks.
risks.mitigation: Oversample scan_id, episode_id, action motif, horizon, body profile, geometry tag, and tentative label before downsampling accepted items.

risks.risk: Free-form Chinese answers may be inconsistently scored.
risks.mitigation: Use explicit canonical labels and accepted aliases; unmatched text is invalid unless manually audited.

risks.risk: Support-risk labels may be invalid in Habitat builds without support-loss signals.
risks.mitigation: Emit `insufficient_support` only with `support_loss=true` or `navmesh_support_violation=true`; otherwise render the three-way hazard variant.

risks.risk: Body counterfactual can still invite radius-prior shortcuts if controls are weak.
risks.mitigation: Require true flips plus both-safe, neither-safe, and large-shorter-same-bin no-flip controls, and report radius-only baselines.

risks.risk: Models may solve Local Progress by recognizing stair/drop semantics instead of estimating body-conditioned progress through visible free space.
risks.mitigation: Reject height/drop/support-risk candidates from Local Progress and route them only to Action-Horizon feasibility or Local Hazard Explanation.

risks.risk: Blind, action-only, or subtype-majority baselines may perform well on Action-Horizon because failure reasons are imbalanced.
risks.mitigation: Make the core Action-Horizon question binary-only, or enforce full multiclass balance across every rendered subtype choice.

risks.risk: A case can pass visibility while the decisive body-boundary collision is hidden or outside the initial RGB.
risks.mitigation: Project sampled swept-footprint boundary and interior points for the tested radius, and for both radii in counterfactual pairs, into the initial view with depth/occlusion checks.

risks.risk: Body Counterfactual can still be partially solved from radius priors if no-flip controls are too sparse.
risks.mitigation: Set explicit minimum accepted-pair quotas for true flips and each no-flip control subtype, then report radius-only baseline performance.

risks.risk: Prompt distances may not match executed simulator movement if step size is not a single frozen metadata field.
risks.mitigation: Freeze forward_step_size_m and turn_step_deg in the generator config and render all meters/body-widths/angles from serialized action sequences.

risks.risk: Accepted cases may depend on hidden future geometry rather than visible single-RGB evidence.
risks.mitigation: Strengthen visible_gate_pass to project sampled swept-footprint boundary and interior points, plus decisive contact/hazard samples, into the initial camera with valid non-occluded depth.

risks.risk: Prompt distances and simulator execution may diverge.
risks.mitigation: Freeze forward_step_size_m=0.25, turn_step_deg=15, serialized action_sequence, intended_distance_m, and render all prompt horizons only from those metadata fields.

risks.risk: Action-Horizon subtype priors may inflate scores.
risks.mitigation: Make the core Action-Horizon prompt binary only; keep failure subtype as metadata or a separately balanced diagnostic.

risks.risk: Body Counterfactual may remain solvable from radius priors if no-flip controls are weak.
risks.mitigation: Enforce explicit quotas for small_only flips, both_safe, neither_safe, and large_shorter_same_bin controls, plus monotonicity rejection and radius-only baseline reporting.
